**The Hiring:**
Auburn hired South Florida head coach Alex Golesh to coach the Tigers beginning immediately. Alex Golesh was hired as the program's 33rd head football coach.

**The Transition:**
Auburn had cycled through four head coaches in the last six years, and Hugh Freeze was the latest coach to depart, with the Tigers now hoping Golesh can provide the stability they have been missing. Auburn fired Hugh Freeze after a 4-5 start to the season in November 2025, before Golesh was hired in December 2025 to begin the 2026 season.

**Early Challenges:**
Just over 24 hours after Alex Golesh was hired, the Auburn Tigers lost three commitments from the 2026 class. The team replaced Hugh Freeze with Alex Golesh, then more than 30 players announced their intent to transfer before Golesh began to bring in his own players, mostly from USF.
